ShortDescription.Value: The in-game advent calendar for Countdown to Chirpmas 2026, the community's festive collaboration.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Get Ready for Chirpmas!** Get ready for the festive season with this creator-run event. Join us in counting down the days to Chirpmas in Cities: Skylines II. From snowy maps to holiday decorations and seasonal buildings, one of our community creators will surprise you with a new gift for your city every day of December until the 24th.
Subscribe to the Chirpmas Asset Pack to keep every release together in game, and follow Const Builds on YouTube for a look at each day's gift. Enjoying one? Leave a like or comment for the creator and share your festive cities using #Chirpmas!
**Who's involved** BadPeanut, civicbeaver, Const Builds, demudann, Ecodragon56, Findus-DE, gagaXm, globati, joergeske, kjmci, MayorCheeks, MrMiyagi10301, poplarponderosa, redlabracer, ReviLoxilef, rzzirrah, ShaneBuilds, TerraineanDev, Tio Auditore, Titann, trist1322, UnMaestro, Vttoc
**About the calendar mod** The in-game advent calendar for **Countdown to Chirpmas 2026**, a community collaboration where creators from the Cities: Skylines II community share a free festive asset, map or mod every day from December 1st to Christmas Eve.
**How it works** - While playing a city, a small Chirpy Santa button appears in the top-left corner. Click it to open the calendar. - A new door opens every day at midnight Central European time (00:00 CET). A red dot on the button tells you when one is waiting. - Click an open door to see the day's gift and who made it. The "Open on Paradox Mods" button takes you straight to its page so you can subscribe to it or add it to your playset. - Newly subscribed assets and maps appear after you restart the game.
**Chirps (optional)** With the "Custom Chirps" mod installed, Chirper announces every new door and shares festive chirps, many of them written by the creators themselves. The creators' chirps only play for the gifts you have enabled in your playset. The intervals can be changed in the mod's options. Without Custom Chirps the calendar works as usual, just without chirps.
This community-made project is not affiliated, endorsed, or sponsored by Paradox Interactive or Iceflake Studios.
Publish.ChangeLog: **Version 1.0.0.2** - The door window now grows with longer descriptions. The cover picture gets bigger and the text gets more room, so there is no big empty space under the picture anymore.
